title: The pause is readable: /health/read carries agents.paused, the control-room decoder and fixtures follow, the Health screen says it
description:
SPIDR child 3a of task-ac71a55ead3d468eab7329131f04ab7e (parent: "the browser says agents are paused"; grandparent task-2723a9b400984ab7b1b10f97c3523c81). dependsOn child 1 task-756d81f117fb4ef6aeca2c676f433c91 (readProviderPause / recordProviderPause on apps/daemon/src/orchestrator/provider-pause-ledger.ts). Filed by architect-16a01670 2026-09-04, measured at main 9e9b7b04.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the daemon read, the control-room decoder + every HEALTH fixture, and the Health screen line. NO shell banner, Seats panel, board next-step, e2e or runbook (children 3b-3d).

MEASURED (re-measure before planning):
- apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.ts (150 lines): `HealthView` :29-49 = {daemon, ledger, outcome:"HEALTH", readAt, verifier}; `HealthReadOptions` :59-69 already carries `clock?: () => string`, `projectId`, `store`; `readHealth` :91-119 builds the frozen view; composition apps/daemon/src/daemon-store-foundation-composition.ts:340-347 builds the port (no clock passed; `config.clock` exists at :339).
- apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.test.ts (77 lines) over a REAL store (`openStore`/`driveThrough` from ../bootstrap/bootstrap-test-fixtures.js): pins `view.daemon` and `view.ledger` with toEqual (:32, :52) - not the whole view - so the new key needs its own arms.
- Control room, THE ONLY exact-key decoder: apps/control-room/src/live/live-ops.ts:215 `exactDataRecord(response, ["daemon","ledger","outcome","readAt","verifier"])`; `HealthOutcome` type :56-78; `mapHealthAnswer` :211-240 (278-line file, pre-existing over the 250 target - record it). Every file that builds a HEALTH frame (grep -rn 'status: "HEALTH"\|outcome: "HEALTH"' apps/control-room/src tests --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx): live-ops.test.ts:20-24 (HEALTH fixture) + :33 (toStrictEqual mapping) + :46-47 (drift arms), ops-screens.test.tsx:31-35 (HEALTH: HealthOutcome), ops-screens.tsx:180-206 (HealthScreen, cr.health.*). Nothing else.

FEATURE: `HealthView.agents = { paused: null | { lastLine: string; provider: string; resetAt: string; since: string; workItemId: string } }`. The daemon reads child 1's `readProviderPause(store, projectId, provider, now)` for each provider of a frozen `KNOWN_PROVIDERS = ["claude", "codex"]` at the port's `clock()` and reports the first live pause (claude first) or null; `lastLine`/`workItemId` come from the pause record's `cause`. `mapHealthAnswer` decodes `agents` with exact keys (a missing `agents`, an unknown key inside `paused`, or a non-string field is OPS_RESPONSE_INVALID; `paused: null` is accepted) and `HealthOutcome` carries it. `HealthScreen` renders a Fact "Agents" with data-testid `cr.health.agents`: "paused: <provider> limit, resumes <resetAt in the viewer's locale>" while paused, "not paused" otherwise.
definitionOfDone: `/health/read` carries `agents: { paused }` with exact keys: health-read.test.ts arms over a REAL store using child 1's recordProviderPause - null with no record; the exact pause object (lastLine, provider, resetAt, since, workItemId) when a claude pause is live at the injected clock; null again at a clock at/after resetAt; a codex pause found when claude has none - written red first, count lines quoted.

live-ops.ts:215 roster, HealthOutcome and mapHealthAnswer carry `agents`; live-ops.test.ts HEALTH fixture + toStrictEqual mapping updated and three drift arms added (agents missing -> OPS_RESPONSE_INVALID; paused with an extra key -> invalid; paused null -> accepted); ops-screens.test.tsx HEALTH fixture updated; HealthScreen renders cr.health.agents 'paused: claude limit, resumes <time>' when paused and 'not paused' otherwise (two ops-screens.test.tsx arms, the time formatted from the fixture's resetAt in the test's own locale).

The composition passes `clock` and the store to the health port; any test pinning the composition's port roster (grep daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts / daemon-store-foundation-composition.test.ts for `health`) stays green and is named in the step note.

taskRails: SHAPE CHANGE NAMED: the HealthView key roster changes exactly once (`agents`); every exact-key decoder, pin and fixture listed in the description is in the plan's affectedFiles before the edit.

DAEMON READ, test first. apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.test.ts: import child 1's `recordProviderPause` (and its aggregate helper if needed) from ../orchestrator/provider-pause-ledger.js; new describe "agents.paused" over `openStore()` + `PROJECT_ID` from ../bootstrap/bootstrap-test-fixtures.js with an injected `clock`: ARM 1 no record -> `view.agents` toEqual({ paused: null }); ARM 2 `recordProviderPause(store, { projectId: PROJECT_ID, provider: "claude", resetAt: "2026-09-02T20:30:00.000Z", since: "2026-09-02T20:00:00.000Z", cause: { workItemId: "node.deliver@node-1", lastLine: "<child 1's claude fixture line, copied verbatim from seat-exit-classifier.test.ts>" } })` (adapt the key names to the landed signature) then a read at clock "2026-09-02T20:10:00.000Z" -> `view.agents.paused` toEqual EXACTLY { lastLine: <that line>, provider: "claude", resetAt: "2026-09-02T20:30:00.000Z", since: "2026-09-02T20:00:00.000Z", workItemId: "node.deliver@node-1" } and `Object.keys(view.agents.paused).sort()` equals those five; ARM 3 the same store read at clock "2026-09-02T20:30:00.000Z" (= resetAt) -> paused null; ARM 4 a fresh store with only a codex pause live -> paused.provider "codex"; ARM 5 both live -> claude wins (KNOWN_PROVIDERS order). Run red. Then apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.ts (150 -> <= 185): `export const KNOWN_PROVIDERS = Object.freeze(["claude", "codex"] as const);` `export interface ProviderPauseView { readonly lastLine: string; readonly provider: string; readonly resetAt: string; readonly since: string; readonly workItemId: string }`; `HealthView` gains `readonly agents: { readonly paused: ProviderPauseView | null }` (declare it between `daemon` and `ledger` so the interface stays alphabetical like the rest); a private `pausedAgents(store, projectId, now)` iterates KNOWN_PROVIDERS, calls child 1's readProviderPause with `now` in the landed form (convert the port's ISO clock if it wants ms) and maps the first live record to a frozen view (lastLine/workItemId from its cause); `readHealth` adds `agents: Object.freeze({ paused: pausedAgents(store, projectId, now) })` where `now = clock()` is read ONCE and reused for `readAt` (one instant per read). A throw inside stays under the existing try/catch -> HEALTH_READ_UNREADABLE (unchanged refusal path; add one arm: a store closed before the read still answers that code). Gate from apps/daemon: `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --config package.json src/http/health-read.test.ts` (count line quoted) + `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck`.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Report every provider's pause as an array - rejected: the browser renders one banner and the wrapper serves one provider per process; `paused: null | object` is the smallest honest shape, KNOWN_PROVIDERS order decides ties. (2) Share one ProviderPauseView type across daemon and control room - impossible: @moe/control-room does not depend on @moe/daemon (package.json deps = contracts, control-room-client, control-room-model, core) and the repo has no tsconfig paths; both sides declare the five-key interface and the decoder pins it by exact keys. (3) A composition test for the clock pass-through - skipped: the composition's port-key roster (daemon-store-dependencies.test.ts:711-720) is unchanged and the pass-through is one identifier; the DoD names that roster test as the guard.
